claims.evidence: PRIDE protocol and processing text identify model, digestion, search settings and TMT labeling. PSI-MS CV names Orbitrap Ascend as MS:1003356.

limitations: The study reports eight animals, four per condition, but the deposited channel map provides conditions only; individual animal IDs and pairing are unavailable.
Sequential Lys-C and trypsin are encoded as repeated cleavage-agent columns by a local builder extension; reconciliation checks only the first and reports a false incomplete warning.
The PRIDE file record does not provide a finer mapping of fractionation order than Fr1-Fr8 in RAW filenames.
